_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate of ±2+ point score moves across 72 windows makes HOLD the skilled default in this coil, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — ETF flows at -11 vs August's positive read and stablecoin growth still negative mean the compression has not resolved.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst calls UP with low conviction while narrative describes compression without a directional call; the split is between wanting to lean bullish (analyst) and refusing to guess (narrative), and the base rate sides with narrative.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows cross above 55 and stablecoin_growth turns positive with btc_momentum_30d holding above 50
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 80 with dxy_strength returning above 50 and btc_momentum_30d falling below 40
